title: StablePDENet: Enhancing Neural Operator Stability through Physics-Informed Residual-Sensitivity Regularization
abstract: arXiv:2601.06472v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Learning solution operators for differential equations with neural networks has shown great potential in scientific computing, but ensuring their stability under input perturbations remains a critical challenge. We introduce the StablePDENet, a physics-informed adversarial training method that regularizes the residual sensitivity with respect to an input perturbation. The operator learning task is formulated as a min--max optimization problem, where the inner model searches admissible input perturbations by physics-based projected-gradient adversary, while the outer problem combines the attacked physics loss with a normalized residual-sensitivity penalty. Moreover, residual-sensitivity regularization is included to ensure that the local Lipschitz constant of the learned operator is a more accurate approximation to that of the exact operator. translated_title: StablePDENet：通过物理信息残差敏感性正则化增强神经算子稳定性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.06472v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：利用神经网络学习微分方程的解算子在科学计算中展现出巨大潜力，但确保其在输入扰动下的稳定性仍然是一个关键挑战。我们引入了StablePDENet，一种物理信息对抗训练方法，该方法通过正则化相对于输入扰动的残差敏感性来提升稳定性。算子学习任务被表述为一个最小-最大优化问题，其中内部模型通过基于物理的投影梯度对抗器搜索可容许的输入扰动，而外部问题则将受攻击的物理损失与归一化残差敏感性惩罚相结合。此外，包含残差敏感性正则化以确保所学算子的局部Lipschitz常数更精确地逼近精确算子的对应值。我们在多个基准问题上评估了StablePDENet。与PI-DeepONet及其变体相比，该方法表现出显著的性能提升。
tldr: StablePDENet通过物理信息对抗训练和残差敏感性正则化，显著增强了神经算子在输入扰动下的稳定性，使其局部Lipschitz常数更接近精确算子。
en_tdlr: StablePDENet enhances neural operator stability under input perturbations through physics-informed adversarial training and residual-sensitivity regularization, making the local Lipschitz constant closer to the exact operator.
